resources.string:
This app uses software rendering mode (hardware acceleration disabled) to simulate WeChat Moments scrolling.

⚠️ Software Rendering Features:
• Only uses UI Thread for rendering
• No RenderThread
• Suitable for CPU-intensive scenario testing

Through three different load modes, you can intuitively compare the performance difference between software and hardware rendering:

Light Load: Small per-frame computation
Medium Load: Moderate per-frame computation
Heavy Load: Large per-frame computation
